title.narrative: Support to the Somali security forces (SSF) working alongside AMISOM

description.narrative: The obejctive of this support is to provide non-lethal, in-kind equipment and light infrastructure support to enable SSF to engage into transition operations alongside AMISOM and to gradually but sustainably take-over security responsibilities from AMISOM.
